title: Worst Cooks in America

The recruits step up to the spotlight in the first-ever Boot Camp Culinary Pageant; it's time to get fancy as chefs Anne Burrell and Gabe Bertaccini teach their teams the delicate art of cooking scallops in the skill drill challenge.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S15 E05 — Merc Story
Ree Drummond shares the story of opening her store, The Mercantile, while making three get-ahead dinners; butternut mac and cheese; Tuscan bean soup; ready to go chili packets for chili dogs, chili nachos and chili cheeseburgers.

title: The Pioneer Woman

Strawberry cherry lemon limeade and awesome orange bars; a great make-ahead dinner on the go with slow cooker lasagna and Missy's marinated tomatoes, ready to eat when the family's done stacking hay.

title: The Pioneer Woman

Ree Drummond celebrates autumn with seasonal favorites, like a fall salad with spicy brittle, very veggie soup and her go-to dish for entertaining, wine-braised chicken with apricots; for a sweet finish, she makes autumn fruit compote sundaes.

title: The Pioneer Woman

Ree Drummond celebrates her late father-in-law with his favorite recipes; she honors his chocoholic lifestyle with skillet chocolate cakes before making biscuits and sausage pepper gravy, tenderloin steak bite and shrimp brochette jalapeño poppers.

title: The Pioneer Woman

Ree Drummond is cooking authentic ranch-style dinners, starting with a family favorite, crispy shrimp tacos, followed by a hearty seven-layer casserole.

Chicken Marsala pasta al forno; kale Caesar salad; pumpkin streusel coffee cake; cauliflower tacos with Sriracha black beans; one pot sausage stew; a round of Try or Deny with new fall flavors.

title: The Kitchen

Cooking up easy weeknight dinners; Katie Lee Biegel prepares roasted fall vegetable pasta salad, Jeff Mauro makes al pastor-style slow cooker tacos, and Geoffrey Zakarian whips up crispy pork-rind breaded chicken.

Damaris Phillips is all about everyone's favorite Halloween decoration, so she tasks the carvers with creating topsy-turvy, gravity-defying stacks of jacks; they must impress the judges with a spooky skeletal structure to stay safe from elimination.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:

The final five pull out all the stops when Damaris Phillips challenges them to create their own superhero and superpower; the competitors depict a scene of the one and only DC's Batman facing off against one of his iconic enemies to save Gotham City.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins

Damaris Phillips has the final four carvers create the winning monster entry in the Miss/Mr. Underworld Pageant and transform 2,000-lb Atlantic Giant pumpkins into a Halloween parade float to prove they're worthy of $25,000 and the prize belt.

Mami Mosas serves up big brunch vibes but is bleeding money; after Chef Lofaso and her sous-chef Nestor Milian uncover untrained cooks, a filthy kitchen and roaches, it's a race to turn things around before the Health Department shuts them down.
